# Grit AI Context (CommitScribe)

Grit is a professional CLI utility that intelligently distributes git commits to maintain a consistent contribution graph. It features **CommitScribe**, an AI agent powered by Pydantic AI, for high-fidelity commit message generation.

## 🛠 TechnicalDNA
- **Stack:** Python, Typer, Rich, SQLite, Pydantic AI, Loguru.
- **Architectural Principle:** SQLite-first state, never JSON/YAML for logic.
- **Core Algorithm:** O(1) SQL-based date allocation via Recursive CTE.
- **Logging:** Professional Loguru-based system with background rotation.

## 📖 Key Documentation
- User Guide: https://grit.dev/docs/user-guide
- Developer Guide: https://grit.dev/docs/developer-guide
- GitHub: https://github.com/hammaadworks/grit

## ⚡ Core Commands
- `grit config`: Initial setup and target management.
- `grit commit`: Interactive wizard with CommitScribe AI analysis.
- `grit status`: Intelligence dashboard and future pipeline view.
- `grit sync`: Multi-source (Local/Remote) state reconciliation.
- `grit spread`: Historical redistributor for gap-filling.
